title: 4.7 Helping at home
unit_outcome: Say where people and things are at home, describe a short daily routine, ask and answer Do you...? questions, and say the day and the time.
goal: Describe opening and closing a door, washing clothes, and cleaning a table with meaningful I, you, we and they perspectives. Reuse familiar home objects and rooms.
grammar_function: Describe opening and closing a door, washing clothes, and cleaning a table with meaningful I, you, we and they perspectives. Reuse familiar home objects and rooms.
prerequisite: Familiar Unit 1 people/actions, Unit 2 objects/park, Unit 3 speakers/possessions and Unit 4 home/morning language.
speaking_outcome: Describe opening and closing a door, washing clothes, and cleaning a table with meaningful I, you, we and they perspectives. Reuse familiar home objects and rooms.

cards.pedagogy_note:
From inside the familiar home, the adult moves the same door from closed to open. Use before-and-after action evidence, not a still of a door already open. Do not imply travel to school or work.
Teach the new action open. Only the new word is the Learn English target; complete statements belong to the practice stages. Spanish help uses the appropriate verb or noun meaning.

Continue from that open door: the addressed boy moves it from open to closed, visibly acting on it. Keep door, room and viewpoint consistent; opening and closing must have opposite before/after order.
Teach close, contrasting the same door action with open. Only the new word is the Learn English target; complete statements belong to the practice stages. Spanish help uses the appropriate verb or noun meaning.

Show a clearly visible pile of shirts and trousers in the familiar bedroom. Garments are large enough to recognize. Introduce clothes as the new noun, not a basket, laundry appliance or fabric-wiping cloth.
Teach clothes. Wash is already familiar from wash my face and is retrieved later. Only the new word is the Learn English target; complete statements belong to the practice stages. Spanish help uses the appropriate verb or noun meaning.

Two familiar family members actively wipe the same table and remove a visible spill or crumbs. Show the action and a before/after change. An empty tidy table alone cannot prove cleaning. Keep the table and room recognizable.
Teach the new action clean on a familiar table. Only the new word is the Learn English target; complete statements belong to the practice stages. Spanish help uses the appropriate verb or noun meaning.
